description: The Lorenz system (sigma = 10, rho = 28, beta = 8/3) from (1, 1, 1): x, y, z over 40 s, and its attractor's statistics.

provenance.method: Taylor series in multiple precision (mpmath): order 40, step 1/256 s, 70 digits; checked against order 30, step 1/128 s, 50 digits. Statistics: an ensemble solved by solve_ivp DOP853 at rtol = atol = 1e-10; the Lyapunov exponent by Benettin's method.
provenance.literature: Viswanath, D. (1998). Global errors of numerical ODE solvers and Lyapunov's theory of stability (PhD thesis, Cornell): 0.905630 to six figures.
